entities.summary: Karel Vejmelka is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Utah Mammoth of the National Hockey League (NHL). Vejmelka, who started his career in the Czech Extraliga, was selected by the Nashville Predators in the fifth round of the 2015 NHL entry draft.
